funding.title: Learning budget & claims
funding.policy: Get HR approval before purchasing. Submit the receipt only after course completion and HR certificate review. Payment happens through your employer, outside Adept. If upfront payment is difficult, ask HR to purchase directly. HRD eligibility does not guarantee funding.
funding.balance: Budget RM {budget} · Reserved RM {reserved} · Paid RM {paid} · Available RM {available}
funding.completionFirst: Finish the course and submit your certificate on Progress. HR must confirm it before this claim can be submitted.
funding.checkReceipt: Check the receipt amount, provider, learner, purchase date and certificate. Confirm that no other reimbursement or HRD claim covers this expense.

packages.title: Compare team learning packages
packages.description: Choose a target role and cohort, then compare course plans for each member. The default role uses existing skill fit, not the largest missing-skills gap.
packages.policy: Packages are proposals with estimated skill levels, time and dated list prices. Selecting sends an assignment to members; it does not enrol them, purchase courses, reserve money or approve reimbursement. Members choose whether to adopt it.
packages.budgets: Set per-person budgets and review claims
packages.summary: Estimated team total RM {cost} · Up to {weeks} weeks · {gaps} skills still unmet across members
packages.withinBudget: Fits the currently available member budgets.
packages.overBudget: Some members exceed their available budget. Adjust funding before any purchase.
packages.memberTime: {hours} study hours at {weekly} h/week · Available employer budget RM {available}
packages.unmet: Skills this course package cannot close
packages.acceptHint: Review the courses and remaining gaps. Adopting replaces your current saved plan; it does not purchase courses or approve funding.
